outcome: Give plant manager / operations excellence director a governed method to improve verified unsafe-zone entry incidents using edge camera events, zone maps and safety procedures, with final decisions…
overview: Industrial Vision Worker Safety Zones addresses inspection evidence is collected unevenly, causing missed defects and inconsistent first-pass decisions in manufacturing operations. The first proof of value uses edge camera events, zone maps and safety procedures. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is verified unsafe-zone entry incidents, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: edge camera events, zone maps and safety procedures; define verified unsafe-zone entry incidents and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Plant Manager / Operations Excellence Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including blind review of representative images across operating conditions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for verified unsafe-zone entry incidents
